about: Slicer settings OpenAMS needs: the toolchange runs in Klipper (T0, T1, ... call the OpenAMS macros, which cut, unload, load and reload), so the slicer writes only the T command and purges after it. Every value here was checked by slicing a two-colour model. The tested versions are listed per slicer.

machine.label: Single Extruder Multi Material
machine.why: One nozzle shared by every filament: changes and purges go through the prime tower.

machine.label: Enable filament ramming
machine.why: On, every change writes ramming, about 94 mm of retracts, cooling moves, a parking move and a 90 mm load around the T, and sets pressure advance to 0 for the rest of the print. OpenAMS cuts and reloads by itself.

machine.label: Purge in prime tower
machine.why: Off, every change purges the process's Prime volume, so the purge never drops below what the cut leaves in the hotend. On, it follows the flushing volumes, which can be much less.

machine.label: Retraction when switching material → Length
machine.why: The toolchange retracts by itself. A slicer retract before the T is added to it, and pushed back after.

machine.label: Change filament G-code
machine.why: OpenAMS's T macros do the whole change. Nothing else belongs here.

machine.label: Wipe tower type
machine.why: Type 2 takes the purge from Prime volume, which a profile can carry. Type 1 takes it only from the project's flushing volumes.

machine.label: Manual Filament Change
machine.why: On, the T commands disappear from the file.

machine.label: High extruder current on filament swap
machine.where: Printer settings → Multimaterial → Single extruder multi-material parameters
machine.why: Meant for the Prusa MMU. Klipper ignores it; keep it off.

process.label: Prime tower → Enable
process.why: Without a tower the T is written at the part and nothing is purged.

process.label: Prime volume
process.why: The purge after each change, in mm³. It has to cover the old filament the cut leaves in the hotend (about 100 mm³ on a Stealthburner with a FilamATrix) plus colour mixing.

process.label: Prime all printing extruders
process.why: On, the print starts by loading every filament in turn.

printer.label: Single Extruder Multi Material, with Extruders = your number of filaments
printer.why: One nozzle shared by every filament. PrusaSlicer builds a wipe tower only with more than one extruder.

printer.label: Cooling tube position
printer.where: Printer Settings → Single extruder MM setup
printer.why: Pulls the filament up to a cooling tube in four retracts. OpenAMS unloads by itself.

printer.label: Cooling tube length
printer.where: Printer Settings → Single extruder MM setup
printer.why: Sets the cooling moves' stroke. At 0 with cooling moves still on, PrusaSlicer writes G1 F-2147483648, which stops a Klipper print: set the filaments' cooling moves to 0 too.

printer.label: Filament parking position
printer.where: Printer Settings → Single extruder MM setup
printer.why: Parks the filament with one more retract, and sets how far the slicer reloads after the T.

printer.label: Extra loading distance
printer.where: Printer Settings → Single extruder MM setup
printer.why: With the parking position, the slicer's load after the T. OpenAMS reloads by itself.

printer.label: High extruder current on filament swap
printer.where: Printer Settings → Single extruder MM setup
printer.why: Meant for the Prusa MMU. Klipper ignores it; keep it off.

printer.label: Retraction when tool is disabled → Length (every extruder)
printer.why: Defaults to 10 mm: G1 E-10 before the T and E+12 after. OpenAMS retracts and reloads by itself.

printer.label: Retraction when tool is disabled → Extra length on restart (every extruder)
printer.why: Extra filament pushed after a change.

printer.label: Purging volume
printer.where: Printer Settings → Single extruder MM setup
printer.why: The purge after each change, in mm³. It has to cover the old filament the cut leaves in the hotend (about 100 mm³ on a Stealthburner with a FilamATrix) plus colour mixing.

printer.label: Tool change G-code
printer.why: OpenAMS's T macros do the whole change. Nothing else belongs here.

print.label: Wipe tower → Enable
print.why: Off by default: then the T is written at the part and nothing is purged.

print.label: Prime all printing extruders
print.where: Print Settings → Multiple Extruders → Wipe tower
print.why: On by default: the print starts by loading, ramming and unloading every filament in turn.

print.label: Ooze prevention
print.why: For printers with several hotends; not with one nozzle.

print.label: No sparse layers
print.where: Print Settings → Multiple Extruders → Wipe tower
print.why: On, the nozzle dives into a tower that is only printed on change layers.

print.value:
"SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE ADVANCE=0
";"";"";"OpenAMS: wipe tower resets Klipper pressure advance and never restores it";"G1 F-2147483648
";"";"";"OpenAMS: invalid feed rate from zero-length cooling moves";"M220 S100
";"";"";"OpenAMS: wipe tower resets the speed factor at every toolchange"
print.label: G-code substitutions (three rules, added to yours)
print.why: Deletes three lines the wipe tower writes even with the settings above: a pressure-advance reset it never undoes, an invalid feed rate, and a speed-factor reset.

filament.label: Ramming settings (no ramming lines)
filament.where: Filament Settings → Advanced → Toolchange parameters with single extruder MM printers
filament.why: PrusaSlicer has no switch to turn ramming off: an empty ramming graph removes its lines.

filament.label: Number of cooling moves
filament.where: Filament Settings → Advanced → Toolchange parameters with single extruder MM printers
filament.why: Shapes a tip by moving the filament up and down in a cooling tube. OpenAMS cuts instead.

filament.label: Delay after unloading
filament.where: Filament Settings → Advanced → Toolchange parameters with single extruder MM printers
filament.why: A pause the toolchange doesn't need.

filament.label: Stamping distance
filament.where: Filament Settings → Advanced → Toolchange parameters with single extruder MM printers
